passages.title: Exact positive and negative exponential-pair tails
passages.inference: Actual pair-law Fubini/Laplace integral gives1/(1+exp s). Swapping variables gives the other tail; the positive and negative events are disjoint for s≥0. Therefore the genuine log-ratio absolute tail equals2/(1+exp s)≤2exp(−s).
